system.description:
You perform a series of quick attacks with enough force to penetrate steel, blasting through your enemy. Make four ranged taijutsu attacks against a target within range dealing your [Weapon’s damage] + 1d8 on a hit.

Chain 2: All attacks made with this jutsu have a +1 bonus to its critical threat range and rolling a 1 or 2 on your ammunition die does not reduce its size.

Chain 3: Each attack inflicts 1 rank of Bleed on an affected creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of attacks by +1.
